description: Delete MANY tasks in one call (bulk). DATA-LOSS. Provide EXACTLY ONE of `ids` or `query`. The single-delete per-title confirmation doesn't generalize to a set, so this needs acknowledge:true to COMMIT — ALWAYS run dry_run:true FIRST to inspect the per-id blast radius ({outcomes:[{id,status,reason}], applied, failed, skipped}), then repeat with acknowledge:true. with_children:true deletes each task's entire inline subtree. Best-effort per-item: one bad id is reported failed and the rest proceed.

acknowledge.description:
REQUIRED to actually delete (the batch-level destructive gate, in
lieu of the single-tool per-title confirmation). Leave false — the
default — to have the call refuse. ALWAYS run with `dry_run:true`
first to inspect the per-id outcome list, THEN repeat with
`acknowledge:true` to commit.

acknowledge_count.description:
REQUIRED for a `query`-based commit delete (dry_run:false):
the number of tasks you expect the query to match. Must equal
the ACTUAL match count or the call is refused before anything is
written. Workflow: `dry_run:true` first to see the count, then
repeat with `acknowledge:true` + `acknowledge_count:<that count>`
to commit. Not required for an `ids`-based delete (self-limiting —
you already enumerated the set) or for a dry-run preview.

acknowledge_ids.description:
F2 TOCTOU close (the STRONGER, identity-based gate): the EXACT set of
ids you saw in the `dry_run:true` preview. When provided for a
`query`-based commit, the server re-resolves the query and refuses
unless the current match set is IDENTICAL to this set — so a
concurrent vault change that swapped a member (same count, different
tasks) between your preview and this commit is caught and rejected,
which `acknowledge_count` alone cannot detect. Recommended for a
`query` delete: pass the ids from the dry-run `outcomes`. Not needed
for an `ids`-based delete (self-limiting) or a dry-run.

allow_partial.description:
Downgrade an unsupported `query` filter condition to a warning
instead of a hard error. Ignored for `ids`.

dry_run.description:
When true, PREVIEW every delete without writing: the full per-id
outcome list is returned, nothing is removed. `acknowledge` is not
required for a dry-run preview.

ids.description:
Explicit corpus ids to delete. Provide EXACTLY ONE of `ids` or
`query`.

now_time.description: Pin the wall-clock "now" (`HH:MM`) used by timed-overdue in `query`.

query.description:
A query expression whose matches are deleted. Provide EXACTLY ONE
of `ids` or `query`.

today.description:
Pin "today" (`YYYY-MM-DD`) for today-relative filters in `query`
(`due:today`, `overdue:`) so the match set resolves identically
between a dry-run count and the commit. Default = the host's day.

with_children.description:
When true, delete each task's ENTIRE inline subtree (the task plus
every nested subtask). DATA-LOSS — dry-run first.

name: bulk_delete_tasks
